review.note: Retracted in M40b: the law of the sea convention signed at Montego Bay in December 1982. Portugal is one of the states it matters most to — the exclusive economic zone, and the extended continental shelf claim filed in 2009 — and the atlas holds no record of any of that, so the convention has nothing here to be wired to. Expo 98 and its ocean theme are not a consequence of it. It would need the continental shelf claim, or the zone itself, as a record.
